title: The Mandalorian
description: Din Djarin, known to most outside of his covert simply as Mando or The Mandalorian, was adopted into the Mandalorians as a foundling during the Clone Wars. While working as a bounty hunter, he collected a youngling named Grogu, and the two bonded almost instantly. Together, they traveled the galaxy as Mandalorians, becoming more and more like father and son.
